---

Issues found on this site that need a change somewhere else, grouped by
the activity that will fix them: the next calibration of the scoring
models, the item banks, the task code and deployment, the scoring
pipeline and releases, or a decision. Each entry links to the page where
the evidence is computed, so the numbers there stay current; the entries
themselves don't repeat them.

The list lives in `register/fixes.csv`. Add an entry when a page turns up
an issue, change its status when it is reported or fixed, and keep fixed
entries (marked Fixed, with the release that fixed them) until the page
that found them confirms the fix.

```{r fixes}
#| results: asis
#| tbl-colwidths: [12, 35, 28, 16, 9]
fixes <- readr::read_csv(here::here("register/fixes.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
activities <- c("Recalibration", "Item banks", "Task code and deployment",
                "Scoring pipeline and releases", "Decisions and new designs")
stopifnot(all(fixes$activity %in% activities))
for (a in activities) {
  d <- fixes[fixes$activity == a, ]
  cat("\n\n# ", a, "\n\n", sep = "")
  print(knitr::kable(d[, c("task", "issue", "action", "evidence", "status")],
                     col.names = c("Task", "Issue", "Action", "Evidence", "Status")))
}
```
